title: PAP Therapy Equipment Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms
content:
# PAP Therapy Equipment Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms

1. **Declining before delivery.** A patient may decline a PAP Therapy Equipment order before delivery at no charge.

2. **Returning a rented device.** A rented device is returned only at the patient's own confirmation: a return pickup request is registered, and the return takes effect when the patient confirms it. A rented device is returned only after a return pickup request on this device record is approved. Whether such a request on this device record is approved is read from the system's records.

3. **Pickup.** The pickup is scheduled within the class's pickup lead in business days of the confirmation.

4. **Billing on return.** Rental billing stops with the last month that began before the return; the month in which the device leaves is not refunded.

5. **Recovery charges.** A device recovered damaged beyond normal wear is charged the class's damage charge. A device still not recovered the class's not-recovered days after the confirmed pickup date is charged the class's charge for a rented device not recovered, which is removed if the device is later recovered.

6. **Owned devices.** A patient-owned device is never picked up or charged on return.

## Charges at a glance

| Situation at recovery | Charge |
|---|---|
| recovered, normal wear | none |
| recovered, damaged beyond normal wear | the class's damage charge |
| not recovered within the class's days after the confirmed pickup date | the class's not-recovered charge, removed if later recovered |
| patient-owned device | never picked up, never charged |

**Billing example (hypothetical dates).** Rental months of a CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) start on the 8th. The patient's return takes effect on 20 June. The month that began on 8 June is the last month that began before the return and is billed; it is not refunded. No month starting 8 July is billed.
